verdict.rationale: dLocal is an API-driven payments platform, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. Its Sandbox lets automated tests simulate payments, check API behavior and trigger webhooks, and a status code in the request controls the outcome, which suits scripted test runs. However, nothing explicitly documents CI or headless usage, and no CLI is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation docs, an official CLI or SDK tooling for pipelines, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: It allows you to safely simulate payments, check API behavior, and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions.
In Sandbox, you can control the payment result by passing a status code in the request body's `description` field.
With dLocal API you can build your own payment form and take full control over the look and feel and experience of your checkout.
